source_findings.finding: Only runAdminDelete changes. Captures the existing parent lifecycle before confirmation opens, then invokes confirmed/closed only after accepted response and the existing account/view/render/root/month guard. Posting cache invalidation remains before stale-view return. No delete preview/token/phrase/request/payload mutation added or changed; member callback path remains await refresh().

Existing createDependentParentLifecycle adds modal identity and latest-parent-read guards. Retained Units read patches board/modal portions while leaving fallback component closure and unrelated settings form nodes intact. Leave reads validate calendar/requests/pressure before patching. Read errors expose GET-only retry without rerunning confirmAdminDelete. These are source properties; shared lifecycle prior evidence is not deletion-specific failure proof.

Accepted deletion clears target selection Set (or whole month Set), but retained DOM selection count/checked state sync is only inside successful Units/Leave readback. If parent GET fails, old checked controls and nonzero Delete selected count can remain while Set is already empty; subsequent click may appear inert. Immediate syncAdminSelection(kind) after guarded selection cleanup is a narrow candidate remedy, pending actual fail/read-recovery assertions.
source_findings.recommendation: Test accepted selected and month deletion with failed parent GET before integration; assert checked boxes/count/disabled state are truthful immediately and retry causes no second delete.

source_findings.finding: unitEditingAssignmentId cleanup now applies commonly to posting target.ids before retained refresh; month target does not explicitly clear it. Baseline cleanup existed only the modal single-posting callback and was bypassed if switching to retained refresh without this move. Assert deleted editor/control removal and unrelated editor drafts survive; do not blanket-clear unrelated assignments.

Deletion dialog finish closes/removes before resolving. Existing parent lifecycle captures whatever element receives restored focus, patches immutable-record keyed controls and avoids stealing newer focus. Test removed opener, surviving selected/month action, ordinary/special Unit modal and Leave day modal; modal navigation/replacement must suppress expired owner results. Also verify parent503/malformed/wrongmonth retry, route/month/account supersession, two simultaneous confirmed lifecycle owners and current newer filter input.

V11 typecheck-effect-proof limits says one new completefallback GET, but actual V11 diff adds no GET call; this inherited registry wording does not describe V11. Correct evidence wording without claiming a new source change.
